topic: A person's online friend turns out to live in the same city
text: I still can't believe it—turns out, my online friend has been just a few miles away this whole time. We've been chatting for months, sharing stories and laughs, and now to find out we're practically neighbors? It's like the universe is giving us a thumbs up. I suggested meeting up for coffee soon to finally put faces to the names. It'll be great to see how our online bond translates in person. Already dreaming up all the adventures we'll have, and I'm really looking forward to seeing just how well we click in real life.
